scope: independent sampled depth/coverage audit of original projected triangles; not a continuous proof

method.geometry: ring_and_occluder(yaw, segments=24) original projected triangle vertices only
method.coordinates: subtract (200,150); source triangles depth-interpolated barycentrically; nearest depth is max z
method.sample_domain: bounding box of original strip triangles; stratified cell centers
method.oracle_strip_visible: max strip depth > max body depth + 1e-10 (or no body) at covered samples
method.ambiguous_samples: exclude source-triangle hits with min absolute barycentric <=1e-10 and strip/body max-depth ties within 1e-10
method.union: bbox-tiled point-in-polygon; zero-area/tiny <=1e-18 polygons and zero-length edges skipped; strict and sampled-boundary-inclusive results reported separately
method.limits: finite samples are observations, not rigorous continuous bounds; source tags are diagnostic only; raster component grouping is not changed

source_subset.tag_semantics: geometry-only source-owner tuple; does not change component/color grouping or raster calls
